column1: # Shared partition table for all builds (4MB flash). Plain A/B:
# the serial flash puts the base image (EasyOTA only) into ota_0; every HTTP
# upload goes to the slot not currently running. A bad upload rolls back to
# the previous image; bad-but-validated images are handled by EasyOTA's
# crash-loop guard and reachability watchdog (see lib/EasyOTA).
# coredump holds the crash dump of the most recent panic
